responsibility: This implementation module implements the simple current-time string helper by calling wrapc.strtime to obtain a C string and copying it into a bounded Modula-2 character array with nul termination. Its responsibility is only textual time retrieval and buffer adaptation, not general date/time arithmetic or libc time structure management.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation side of the TimeString pair: it fetches the C time string from wrapc.strtime and copies it into the Modula-2 buffer with bounds checks and nul termination, while TimeString.def only declares GetTimeString.
